description: BC Partners partnered with Acuris (formerly The Mergermarket Group) in February 2014. Acuris is a global financial information provider, specialising in the provision of financial news, intelligence, and data to paying subscribers. The global market leader in niche markets of M&A and credit news and intelligence services, Acuris provides timely and actionable intelligence to support its clients’ business development activities. Acuris accelerated its growth trajectory under BCP ownership. Management, supported by the BCP team, executed many successful initiatives including the overhaul of the technology platform; geographical expansion; the launch of new products, content and data sets; the optimisation of the sales force incentive structure; the reorganisation into six verticals and rebranding; and nine accretive acquisitions. Presently, Acuris remains the leading provider of proprietary, actionable intelligence, data and analytics to principal advisory firms, investment banks, law firms, hedge funds, private equity firms, and corporates globally. In June 2017, BCEC IX agreed to sell a 31% stake in Acuris to GIC. On 13 May 2019, Funds advised by BC Partners announced the sale of a majority stake in Acuris to ION Investment Group (“ION”). ION will acquire a controlling stake in the company from BC Partners and GIC, and both BC Partners (BCEC X) and Acuris management are reinvesting and will retain minority ownership.

BC Partners acquired a minority stake in Acuris (formerly The Mergermarket Group) in 2019. Acuris is a global financial information provider, specialising in the provision of financial news, intelligence, and data to paying subscribers. The global market leader in niche markets of M&A and credit news and intelligence services, Acuris provides timely and actionable intelligence to support its clients’ business development activities. BC Partners acquired a minority stake alongside ION Investment Group.

In September 2012, BC Partners acquired Aenova. Aenova is now the #1 European and #3 worldwide CDMO and provides product development and manufacturing services for pharma / consumer healthcare customers. The company offers solid, semi-solid and liquid dosage forms with leading positions in attractive technologies and markets, including solids, softgel caps, sterile and special substances and animal health. In April 2024, BC Partners sold a majority take in Aenova to Kühne Holding AG.

In July 2012, BC Funds acquired Altice USA (Cablevision - Suddenlink) in a proprietary transaction. Altice USA (Cablevision - Suddenlink) is the 7th largest US cable TV company focused mainly on smaller markets in the mid-west and south of the country. Altice USA (Cablevision – Suddenlink) is the 7th largest US cable TV company focused mainly on smaller markets in the mid-west and south of the country. Suddenlink specialises in cable-television, high-speed internet, broadband phone, home security and advertising. In December 2015 Suddenlink was sold to Altice S.A. with BC and co-investors retaining a significant stake in the business. At the time of the sale Suddenlink had 1.5 million residential and 90,000 business subscribers. Soon after, Altice acquired Cablevision in June 2016, the leading cable operator in the New York metropolitan area, which represents an attractive US cable market characterised by affluence and population density. BC exercised the option to participate pro rata in the further development of the business, which was renamed Altice USA and is now the number four cable operator in the US with c. 4.6m customers across more than 20 states. Altice USA IPO-ed in June 2017, and trades on the NYSE under the symbol “ATUS”.

BC Partners acquired Allflex in July 2013 (since renamed Antelliq) from the long-term owner of the business. Initially a pure provider of identification devices to farmers, since its original acquisition, BC Partners supported management in transforming Antelliq into the worldwide leader in animal intelligence, providing solutions for the management of livestock, pets and fish. Antelliq is now the world’s leading animal intelligence group, providing world-class devices for animal identification, monitoring, and traceability. Its pioneering monitoring solutions deliver smart data products and services for the management and wellbeing of livestock, fish and pets. These solutions help veterinarians, farmers and pet owners gather critical data to improve management, health and well-being of livestock and pets and use digital technology to help respond to the growing demand for protein, food traceability and food safety. As a truly innovative market leader with a clear vision and dynamic team, Antelliq has significant potential to continue leading the industry, as the use of intelligence, data and technology play an increasingly important role in animal health and care and on the back of strong trading, in December 2018, the Fund entered into an agreement with Merck to sell the company, which completed in March 2019.

description: In January 2026, BC Partners acquired Biogaran, one of France’s largest generic drug companies Biogaran, a leader in the generic market in France and an active contributor to cost savings in the French healthcare system, was founded over 25 years ago. Over the years, the company has established itself as a key player in the pharmaceutical industry. Today, Biogaran offers treatments across the full spectrum of therapeutic areas — from everyday conditions to the most serious diseases — and supplies a wide range of medicines, including antibiotics, antidiabetics, and anticancer drugs.

In March 2018, BC Partners acquired Ceramtec, the global leading provider of high-performance ceramics (“HPC”) solutions, with 20 production sites and 3,500 FTEs in 11 countries. With a well-diversified product portfolio of >20,000 SKUs the company is active in two segments: Medical – Ceramic components for joint implants Industrial – Highly specialised, mission critical HPC solutions. In March 2022, BC XI and Canada Pension Plan Investment Board acquired CeramTec from the existing shareholders BCEC X, OTPP, and PSP.

In March 2022, BC Partners acquired CeramTec, a global provider of high-performance ceramics with a focus on MedTech applications. The Company, which BC Partners and Canada Pension Plan Investment Board acquired from the existing shareholders BCEC X, OTPP, and PSP, is the undisputed global leader in the provision of ceramic components for hip replacements, with a growing position in orthopaedic and dental adjacencies. The company is headquartered near Stuttgart, Germany, with c. 3,500 employees operating across 19 production sites globally.

Cigierre was acquired by BC Partners in January 2016 and is the market leader in Italian casual dining market operating more than 300 sites under two main brands, Old Wild West and Wiener Haus. As the No. 1 operator in the highly fragmented and relatively underdeveloped Italian casual dining market Cigierre‘s market leadership has been further strengthened through organic growth and acquisitions of 4 further concepts in Italy and internationally.

In March 2021, BC Partners acquired Davies Group. Davies is an increasingly international provider of professional services and technology enabled outsourcing solutions to the insurance industry, with a leading position in the UK and a growing presence in the US. The company employs 4,000 people supporting more than 800 clients around the world, and in recent years has expanded into new markets including Bermuda, Canada and the US. Through a combination of organic growth and strategic acquisitions, the firm has increased its annual proforma revenues six-fold over the last 4-years, to more than £350 million and Davies has been recognised as one of the UK’s fastest growing international businesses for two consecutive years.

In June 2017 BC Partners acquired DentalPro, the leading operator in the large, growing and underpenetrated Italian dental market. DentalPro is the market leader in the Italian dental clinic market, offering high-quality dental care through 150 full-service clinics. Operating across 40 Italian provinces, and overseas, DentalPro partners with local dentists to provide comprehensive practice management support and training, allowing practitioners to focus on delivering accessible care to their patients.

description: In May 2021, BC Partners agreed to acquire EAB, the leading provider of subscription-based research, software and technology-enabled services to the higher education industry. The company’s mission is to make education smarter and our communities stronger by harnessing the collective power of more than 2,100 schools, colleges, and universities to uncover transformative insights and apply proven best practices. EAB employs over 1,300 people and is headquartered in Washington, DC. BC Partners acquired the company in a joint partnership with existing investor, Vista Equity Partners.

description: In November 2016, BC Partners completed the carve‐out of 22 mental health assets, to create the newly formed company Elysium. Elysium operates a portfolio of 66 mental healthcare facilities (22 as part of the original perimeter and 44 acquired or developed since closing) which together form one of the leading independent providers of behavioural health services in the UK. The company is focused on mental health inpatient services in the UK, specialising in inpatient care for higher risk patients requiring treatment in a secure or controlled-access rehabilitation environment.

In November 2022, BC Partners acquired Fedrigoni. Founded in 1888, Fedrigoni is a leading global producer of self-adhesive labels and high value-added papers for luxury packaging and other creative solutions. The company, which BC Partners acquired alongside Bain Capital Private Equity, currently has more than 4,500 employees in 27 countries and 48 facilities, including production plants, cutting centres and distribution centres. The Group sells and distributes 25,000 products in 132 countries and, thanks in part to recent acquisitions, has gained the position of a leading global player in wine labels, specialty papers for luxury packaging, drawing paper and self-adhesive materials. In 2022 the company also entered the fast-growing RFID technology space with the acquisition of Tageos. Fedrigoni has embedded sustainability into its business strategy, including ongoing efforts to reduce its environmental impact and to support customers in tackling their transition towards ecological practices and an increasingly circular business. It has in 2022 received a Platinum EcoVadis sustainability rating, which places Fedrigoni in the top 1% of companies in the same industry worldwide.

Established in 1985 and headquartered in Treviso, Italy, Forno d’Asolo (FdA) is a leading international manufacturer and distributor of frozen artisanal bakery products. The story BC Partners invested in FdA Group in 2018, acquiring the company from 21 Investimenti. Alongside a successful history of investment in the food sector, BC Partners leveraged four decades of active investment experience in Italy to successfully position itself as the partner of choice, including a proven track record of working with families and founders and a reputation for delivering international growth strategies. At the time of investment, FdA was delivering €130 million of annual revenue, with an EBITDA of €24 million, but the company’s loyal customer base, robust market position, and unique direct distribution platform offered significant growth potential. € 130 m Annual revenue € 24 m EBITDA The BC angle Extensive experience in European Food sector Reputation and network in Italy facilitating early access and engagement Relationship with CEO built on BC’s track record A ‘BC Company’ in a Resilient, Growing and Fragmented Market with significant growth optionality Our investment thesis Building a better business Following the acquisition, BC Partners worked closely with the FdA Group management team, transforming the business into an international champion in frozen bakery and pâtisserie products – a position which it retains to this day. This was achieved through several organic and inorganic growth initiatives that included: Our results together During BC Partners’ five-and-a-half-year partnership with the FdA Group, the company successfully navigated the challenges of the COVID-19 pandemic. Despite initial challenges in 2018, FdA Group went on to recover and quadruple in size, expand its product range and reach almost €500 million in sales with c€85 million EBITDA in 2023. Additionally, FdA’s customer base grew almost 50%, and its headcount grew approximately 7x, reaching 1,200 full-time employees. In February 2024, BC Partners announced the sale of FdA Group to a consortium comprising the Bagnoli family-owned Sammontana, a leading Italian frozen pastry and gelato manufacturer and distributor, and Investindustrial. The deal marks a new chapter for FdA Group as it continues to build on its impressive legacy. Founded in 1993 and headquartered in Milan, Italy, Fortidia is a global leader in providing shipping, fulfilment, print, and marketing solutions Operating under multiple complementary franchised brands, including – among others – Mail Boxes Etc., AlphaGraphics, World Options and PostNet, Fortidia plays a pivotal role in the high-growth parcel, packing, shipping and fulfilment value chain, as well as providing outstanding marketing solutions. The Company acts as a key player in the end-to-end logistics and complementary business services arenas and is growing rapidly to serve its on-line and off-line customers in a highly fragmented global market. BC Partners acquired a majority stake in 2025 through a bilateral transaction. This transaction marks the first investment in BC Partners Fund XII.

Founded in 1995 by CEO Stephan Crétier, GardaWorld has grown to become one of the world’s largest privately-owned security services providers. Headquartered in Montreal and with operations around the globe, the company offers a wide range of services across physical and tech-enabled security solutions, as well as end-to-end cash management. BC Partners acquired a majority stake in 2019 through a bilateral transaction that valued the company at C$5.2bn — the largest private buyout in Canadian history at the time. The BC angle Leveraged deep expertise in recurring commercial services to proactively identify and quickly build conviction in GardaWorld Drawing on the firm’s extensive Canadian network and long-standing reputation for partnership with founders and entrepreneurs, we engaged early with GardaWorld’s founder and CEO, Stephan Crétier, to unlock a bilateral transaction Our investment thesis Building a better business Under our ownership, and in partnership with management, the company has delivered on an ambitious growth strategy to create a bigger and better business. In North America, the company executed 11 tuck-in acquisitions to solidify GardaWorld’s leading position in Canada and create a national platform in the large, high-growth US market. Through a combination of M&A and organic investment, the company launched two new tech-enabled platforms: ECAMSECURE (remote & virtual surveillance) and Crisis24 (risk management), which provide GardaWorld with exposure to technology growth tailwinds and add high-margin, recurring revenues to the company. Through five strategic acquisitions in the cash automation space, GardaWorld transformed its cash services division into the industry’s only end-to-end cash management platform, with exciting growth opportunities and high-margin, subscription revenue streams. Entering 2024, the company had successfully transformed into a true global leader. In five years of partnership with BC, GardaWorld more than doubled in size, expanded profit margins, and accelerated organic growth. Most importantly, the company was ready for the future, with a market-leading suite of tech-enabled security and cash management services that position it to drive organic growth for years to come. Our results together Having already outpaced our original value creation plans we shifted our attention to designing a unique exit that would satisfy three goals. First, to crystalise an attractive return for our investors, second, to participate in the future value creation opportunities provided by GardaWorld’s ongoing success, and lastly, to deliver on our partnership with Stephan Crétier and management by helping them achieve their long-held goal of taking majority control of the company. In October 2024, we signed an exit agreement, recapitalising GardaWorld in a C$13.5bn transaction that saw management take a majority ownership stake, with HPS Investment Partners and a group of co-investors acquiring a minority stake. As part of the transaction, BC Partners maintains a minority interest — a reflection of our continued conviction in the company’s potential. GardaWorld's continued success Driven by a relentless entrepreneurial culture and core values of integrity, vigilance, trust and respect, GardaWorld remains the security partner of choice for many of the world’s most prominent brands, influential individuals, Fortune 500 corporations, and governments. As a minority investor, BC Partners is fully committed to supporting GardaWorld’s management team as they work to continue the business’ success and take the company to even greater heights.

In March 2025, BC Partners acquired a majority stake in GFL’s Environmental Services division (GES), a leading provider of liquid waste management and soil remediation services in Canada and the US. Its vertically integrated offering includes on-site field services, collection, transport, treatment, and final disposal of waste. The company has grown organically and through accretive M&A to become a Canadian leader and North American consolidator, with market-leading ESG credentials. BC Partners acquired a majority stake in the company alongside Apollo, with GFL maintaining a minority ownership stake.

BC Partners invested in GFL Environmental, a leading North American provider of diversified environmental solutions, in May 2018. GFL is the only major diversified environmental services company in North America offering services in solid waste management, liquid waste management and infrastructure development. GFL operates across Canada and in 20 states in the United States, with over 9,000 employees providing local service to approximately 4 million households under municipal contracts, and more than 135,000 industrial, commercial and institutional customers.

description: In October 2022, BC Partners acquired Havea, the leading European natural healthcare player. Founded in 1975 and formerly Ponroy Santé, Havea is a France-based leading European natural healthcare group. The Company operates five strategic brands focused on natural healthcare with diversified positioning and patient profiles: Vitavea (everyday food supplements), Aragan (premium food supplements), Biolane (baby care), Dermovitamina (skin care) and Densmore (ophthalmology and gynaecology). The business has a history of consistently delivering above-market organic growth as a result of end-to-end coverage of the value chain from product development to distribution, an omnichannel approach and a unique activation strategy relying on both sell-in and sell-out levers. Havea currently employs over 800 people, and is headquartered in Boufféré, France, where it manufactures the majority of its product portfolio.

BC Partners first invested in IMA in 2020. Founded in 1961, IMA is a global manufacturer of packaging and processing machinery serving the pharmaceutical, food, cosmetics, and e-mobility sectors. Recognising the company’s strong market position and growth potential, BC Partners first invested in 2020, partnering with SOFIMA, the controlling shareholder, to acquire a stake. By 2021, IMA operated 45 production sites across Europe and Northern Italy, catering to a blue-chip customer base, and demonstrated robust potential for innovation and international expansion. Its strategic focus on automation and sustainability aligned with global trends in digital transformation and the demand for environmentally responsible solutions, reinforcing its long-term growth trajectory. Despite COVID-19-related supply chain disruptions, IMA remained resilient, providing essential equipment such as vaccine and face-mask production lines to governments and pharmaceutical companies. In 2021, BC Partners and the Vacchi family acquired full control of IMA Group and delisted it from the Milan Stock Exchange, in what was one of the largest European take-private transactions of that year. The BC Angle Leveraging 35 years of sector experience, BC Partners’ extensive Italian network unlocked a bilateral, proprietary agreement. A strong local reputation and entrepreneurial mindset made BC Partners the preferred partner for IMA’s management team and founding Vacchi family. BC Partners’ sector insight, thematic focus, and expertise in pharma, packaging and industrial automation built strong conviction even amid the uncertainties of COVID-19. Investment thesis Building a better business Following the acquisition, BC Partners worked closely with management, guiding the company through a strategic transformation that diversified the business and reinforced its global leadership position. Key initiatives included: Under BC Partners’ ownership, IMA achieved €2 billion in revenue by 2022 and increased EBITDA by 70%. This strong momentum drew significant inbound interest, with BC Partners agreeing to sell its stake to BDT & MSD Partners in July 2023. The sale valued IMA at €6.9bn, more than double its value since BC’s initial investment. Continued success IMA now operates in over 80 countries and 53 production facilities. The company serves a broad customer base across multiple regions, including Europe, North America, South America, Asia, and the Middle East. IMA’s installed base of approximately 60,000 machines and its more than 3,000 patents reinforce its leadership position in the packaging and automation sectors.

In August 2025, BC Partners acquired IGS GeboJagema. Founded in 1945 and headquartered in Eindhoven, the Netherlands, IGS GeboJagema is the global leading, pure-play healthcare, high-precision mould technology provider. IGS designs and manufactures complex, high-precision moulds used in the production of critical medical devices, including drug delivery systems, contact lenses, diagnostic equipment and healthcare consumables. With decades of specialised expertise and delivering to exacting standards, IGS has built a strong reputation as a global leader, in the supply of mission-critical tooling to the world’s leading healthcare and pharmaceutical companies.

description: In January 2021, BC Funds acquired Keesing, the leading developer and publisher of puzzle content globally. Keesing enjoys significant differentiation driven by its technology platform, which generates the highest quality puzzles at the lowest cost. The Company is well positioned to benefit from the increased focus on brain health. It owns a number of market-leading brands and is also in the process of releasing new digital offerings, which will allow it to leverage its existing content to new audiences.

In December 2022, BC Funds acquired Madison Logic, a global leader in Account Based Marketing. Madison Logic provides advanced B2B ABM services through its proprietary, industry-leading account-based marketing platform to improve its clients’ sales and marketing results. According to Forrester Research, sustainable B2B pipeline growth requires a clear focus on spotting buying groups, responding to digital signals, and optimizing the path toward a buying decision. With the increase in corporate purchasing and selling online, sales and marketing teams need to work closely together to enable a data-driven approach to marketing aligned with accounts. The Company meets the needs of these changing buyer preferences and behaviours with its integrated approach to data-driven, multi-channel ABM that enables marketers to drive higher engagement, accelerate the sales cycle, and deliver exceptional ROI.

description: BC Partners acquired Navex in 2018, the recognized leader in risk and compliance management software-as-a-service. The company serves over 13,000 customers in more than 85 countries worldwide, including 91 of the Fortune 100. Formed in 2012 by the joining of four GRC software industry leaders with histories leading back as far as 1981, NAVEX solutions provide a unified view of risk across the business. This allows for deeper organizational insight, increase operational efficiencies, and more informed decision making. At its core, the company’s mission is to help customers promote ethical, inclusive workplace cultures, protect their brands, and preserve the environment through sustainable business practices.

In 2019, BC Partners acquired a co-control stake in OneAdvanced, a leading UK provider of mission-critical vertical ERP software to mid-sized companies and organisations. Headquartered in the UK, the Company serves c. 4,500 core customers across the private and public sector. The Company focuses on non-cyclical sectors, with leading positions across health and social care, legal services, local government, education, and distribution & logistics. For these customers, Advanced offers leading sector-specific portfolios, consisting of both critical vertical applications and core horizontal solutions, and supported by a joined-up platform that provides a compelling customer experience as well as strong tech foundations, including AI services and functionality.

Founded in 2018, PetLabCo. is a premium independent animal health brand offering a range of pet supplements to address common ailments and promote overall wellness. Products include probiotic chews, dental cleaning powder, allergy and immune chews, and joint care chews. PetLabCo.’s digitally-native model covers both direct-to-consumer via its own website and online marketplaces including Amazon and Chewy, with significant white space across other retail channels and vet practices.

Acquired in 2023, PetSmart is the leading bricks and mortar specialty pet retailer in North America, with 1,600+ stores across the US and Canada. PetSmart, which BC Partners acquired alongside Apollo, is seen as a destination for pet parents and their pets, with the widest in-store variety of pet products, including food, treats, toys, and accessories. Additionally, it has the largest pet services offering in the country, including grooming, training, boarding, and veterinary care.

Acquired in March 2015, PetSmart is the leading bricks and mortar specialty pet retailer in North America, with 1,600+ stores across the US and Canada. PetSmart is seen as a destination for pet parents and their pets, with the widest in-store variety of pet products, including food, treats, toys, and accessories. Additionally, it has the largest pet services offering in the country, including grooming, training, boarding, and veterinary care. PetSmart was acquired in March 2015 in a public to private (PtoP) transaction by a consortium led by funds advised by BC Partners along with a number of Limited Partners. In May 2017, PetSmart acquired Chewy.com, the leading online specialty pet retailer in the US., significantly expanding its presence in e-commerce.

In 2015, BC Partners acquired Pharmathen, a leading European pharmaceutical company focused upon developing, manufacturing and out-licensing complex generic drugs, from the founding family. Pharmathen has a B2B Business Model and focuses on: out-licensing to over 265 customers in over 85 countries; Manufacturing Supply Agreements with minimum 5-year contracts; and a portfolio of 110 own-developed drugs. Additionally, Pharmathen undertakes R&D in Greece with 2 facilities, along with manufacturing at 2 facilities, also in Greece. In July 2021, BC Partners announced the sale of Pharmathen to Partners Group.

Founded in New York in 2003, Presidio is an IT solutions provider focused on serving SMEs with expertise across the entire range of customers’ needs, including cloud computing, digital infrastructure, and security solutions. The Company has more than 6,660 customers worldwide, and and has long-standing relationships with leading technology providers including Amazon, Microsoft, Cisco and Dell. The BC Angle Extensive experience in US TMT and Business Services Insights into Middle Market IT Services through prior investments Bilateral public to private transaction A ‘BC Company’ with attractive defensive growth characteristics The story In 2019, recognising the company’s significant growth potential (leveraging insights on US middle-market IT services gained through prior investment in Altice), and defensive growth characteristics, BC Partners positioned itself as ‘Partner of Choice’ to management and acquired the Nasdaq listed company in a $2.1 billion take-private transaction. Investment thesis Building a better business Under BC Partners’ ownership, the company initiated and completed a transformative growth plan, driving strong growth across key financial metrics and solidifying its position as a leading, international cloud services business. BC Partners and Presidio management strategically pivoted the company to cloud, software and cybersecurity services which drove a meaningful uplift in performance. This repositioning delivered organic growth acceleration, margin expansion, and a significant increase in recurring revenue mix. Identifying M&A expansion as a key growth driver, BC Partners also coordinated four accretive acquisitions that maximised market expansion and cross-selling opportunities. This included the transformational ‘tuck-in’ integration of ArkPhire, which drove Presidio’s expansion into key European markets, and Coda, which supercharged the Company’s growth in cloud services. BC Partners also focused on improving Presidio’s operational capabilities. Working closely with the Presidio team, BC Partners supported the company through key managerial transitions, including a new CFO and Head of Business Development, as well as supported a number of operational initiatives in areas including working capital management. Our results together In 2024, having executed on its investment thesis and delivered its ambitious growth plan, BC Partners agreed to sell its majority interest in Presidio to Clayton Dubilier & Rice (CD&R). BC Partners retains a minority investment in the company, reflecting their conviction in Presidio’s continued success.

Sabre Insurance Group is a specialist UK private motor insurer with expertise in non-standard motor insurance that was acquired in 2014. The company has has an established track record of market leading underwriting performance and a broad underwriting footprint and multi-channel distribution through a network of c. 1,000 intermediaries (indirect) and through its own three Direct Brands – Go Girl, Drive Smart and Insure 2 Drive. Shawbrook is a specialist lender with a diversified and growing balance sheet serving SMEs, property investors and consumers in the UK. The company operates across Property Finance, Business Finance, Consumer Lending and Savings. For more information on Shawbrook, please watch the video here .

BC Partners acquired a stake in Springer Nature alongside a single-asset acquisition fund led by Neuberger Berman and managed by BC Partners in 2021. Springer Nature is the #2 academic research publisher, leveraging 175 years of experience in supporting the academic community. Headquartered in Berlin, the company was created through the merger of Springer Science and Macmillan Publishing in 2015. The company operates a global network of c. 90,000 expert academic editors and c. 750,000 PhD peer reviewers and publishes c. 300,000 articles per annum in around 3,000 journals, including under the prestigious Nature brand. Springer Nature holds leading positions in some of the most attractive and fastest growing segments such as prestigious high impact factor journals, full open access or academic e-books.

description: Established in 1991, Synthon is a leading global developer of complex generic pharmaceuticals, whose products are approved by regulators in over 100 countries. With more than 200 customers worldwide, Synthon’s 1,600 employees deploy state-of-the-art facilities to develop, manufacture, and — in select markets — distribute new generic drugs. The BC angle BC Partners was able to leverage its deep sector expertise, local knowledge and prior experience from investments in Aenova and Pharmathen. Following three years of tracking the company’s progress and building relationships with founders and management, BC Partners secured advantaged access, enabling a bilateral partnership. BC Partners’ existing relationships in the sector positioned the firm as the preferred partner. Investment thesis The story BC Partners leveraged its extensive sector expertise in pharmaceuticals and generic drug development, including prior investments in companies such as Pharmathen, which enabled the firm to identify Synthon as a market leader with standout potential, supported by long-term growth tailwinds, strong leadership, and first-rate research capabilities and infrastructure. Building on the work of Synthon’s founders, and working closely with management, BC Partners invested heavily in complex technologies to expand Synthon’s manufacturing capabilities and drive the business into new geographies, including additional US and Middle Eastern markets. Additionally, BC Partners helped to identify the white space in core markets, particularly the company’s B2B operations. Building a better business Doubling down on Synthon’s commercial and operational excellence, R&D, and technological differentiation, BC Partners successfully worked alongside management to: Our results together Under BC Partners’ active ownership, Synthon expanded rapidly, more than doubling EBITDA organically, with growth generating over 80% of returns, underpinned by strong EBITDA margin expansion. In 2024, Synthon was sold to Goldman Sachs Alternatives, who acquired a majority stake in the company. As part of the transaction, BC Partners retained a minority stake in the business, demonstrating its ongoing commitment to Synthon’s growth and performance. Hear from Anish Mehta, CEO of Synthon

In 2015, BC Partners acquired a significant minority share in Teneo, a global CEO advisory firm that works exclusively with the CEOs and leaders of the world's largest and most complex companies providing strategic counsel across their business. Teneo operates across four operating segments: Strategy & Communications Advisory, Capital Advisory, Risk Advisory, and Management Consulting. Based in New York City with offices in 18 cities, including a major operation in London and Dubai, among Teneo’s clients are multi-national Fortune 500 companies, philanthropies, and high-net-worth individuals. In June 2019, BC Partners sold the shareholding in Teneo to CVC.

In September 2021, BC invested in Tentamus Group, a leading testing services business with an established pan European presence and a strong, fast-growing foothold in the US and Asia. The Company offers a wide range of lab services to ensure quality and safety of products that ‘affect humans from the inside’ resulting in a clear focus on the most attractive segments of the TIC industry: food, pharma, and medtech. The combination of strong organic growth and a focused M&A strategy has enabled Tentamus to grow rapidly over the last 5 years. Tentamus now operates over 90 labs in c. 25 countries

In 2019, The BC Funds acquired United Group, the leading integrated cable and media operator in South Eastern Europe. United Group is the leading telecommunications and media group in Southeastern Europe. Operating across eight countries with more than 15,000 employees, the Group achieves an annual revenue of over c. €3 billion. In the telecommunications sector, more than 5.42 million households and more than 7.65 million mobile subscribers benefit from the largest FTTH (Fiber to the Home) network in Southeastern Europe, intensive investments in United Group’s 5G network, and state-of-the-art fixed and mobile connectivity.

Valtech, which was acquired by BC Partners in 2021, designs, builds and runs digital experience, commerce and connected platforms for 600 customers across industries globally. Headquartered in New York and London, Valtech has a long track record of organic growth, and the business has developed referenceable digital expertise and scaled relationships with a roster of blue chip customers. This organic growth has been supplemented by a well-structured and accretive M&A program.

VetPartners was acquired by BC Funds in November 2018, and is a leading operator of small animal, mixed and equine veterinary practices in the UK. VetPartners was founded in October 2015 and operates over 350 clinics and has proven itself the fastest growing consolidator of the UK veterinary practices market, adding c.80 vet clinics annually to the group. As the company has grown, management has developed a hub‐and‐spoke strategy in order to maximise revenue and take advantage of capacity and capabilities across the network, particularly by maintaining high‐value referral work inside the group.

In December 2020, BC Partners acquired Women’s Care Enterprises (WCE), a leading provider of women’s health services including Obstetrics / Gynecology (OB/GYN), primarily in the state of Florida with operations in California and Kentucky. The company employs over 250 equity and employed physicians and over 130 midwives and other medical professionals. WCE has almost 1 million annual visits. Revenue mix is highly diversified coming from a mixture of routine and episodic care including obstetrics, routine care, fertility, mammography, surgeries, ultrasound and imaging, and lab services.

Zest Dental Solutions, a dental implant manufacturer, was acquired in March 2018. Zest provides removable and fixed implant restorative solutions, world class narrow diameter implant systems, and dental materials and products for overdenture modification and processing to clinicians treating the real world problems associated with edentulism (patients with no teeth). The company has also further diversified its product portfolio with acquisitions of Danville Materials, a leader in small equipment and dental consumables, and Iveri Whitening. This diversification makes Zest a true solutions based company for a continuum of patient care from the preservation of natural teeth to the treatment of total edentulism.
